finalText: Build now exits 0. The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js:17` — `maxRetries: retries` referenced an undefined variable (should've been `env.retries`), throwing a `ReferenceError` that aborted the link stage. The three `WARN` lines in the log (deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, an unused export, a circular import) were red herrings unrelated to the crash — worth cleaning up eventually but not build-breaking.
